0022600134.text: The Pistons (3-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) host the Hornets (3-1, 1st in the Southeast and 3rd in the East), with Detroit riding a three-game winning streak and a 1-0 home record. Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won their 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 118-100 win in Charlotte on April 10, 2026.
